title: Health Resort west wing room 301 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 301 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 301 key (W301 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 301.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 304 through the balcony

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - On a seat on the yellow bus by the collapsed tunnel.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 301 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 301:
  - Loose loot
  - 1x Graphics card spawn
  - 1x LEDX spawn on the white crates.

- Room 304:
  - One Weapon box (6x6)
  - Two PC's
  - Loose loot (Computer parts, Meds, Money)
  - 2x Graphics card spawn
  - One Weapon Spawn (SV-98)
  - Multiple LEDX spawns
